contact.title_zh: 機器人控制與 Physical AI 工程師

summary.en: AI Robotics Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, focused on ROS 2, Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, cuMotion, visual servoing, and physical-robot validation. Experienced in connecting perception, force-guided contact search, robot learning, policy inference, and Dockerized robotics software into practical manipulation workflows.
summary.zh: AI 機器人工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，專注於 ROS 2、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2、cuMotion、視覺伺服與實體機器人驗證。具備將感知、力導向接觸搜尋、Robot Learning、Policy Inference 與 Docker 化機器人軟體整合至實際操作流程的經驗。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Built ROS 2 control and simulation workflows for industrial and collaborative robot platforms with Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MoveIt 2, and cuMotion, covering motion planning, collision handling, pick-and-place, and cable tasks.

Delivered Isaac GR00T N1.7 data conversion, model training, and policy inference, separately validating virtual-data training followed by real-world inference and real-data training/inference workflows.

Built a two-part ROS 2 / WebSocket training-data collection flow that automated robot-arm tasks and recorded actions, images, robot state/actions, and timestamps, reaching 3-4x manual throughput and reducing manual staffing needs by two operators.

Developed YOLO OBB / OpenCV visual servoing for HDMI insertion and AprilTag / OpenCV connector localization for cable unplugging; integrated wrist-mounted six-axis force/torque sensing and force-guided contact search into final insertion alignment with bounded spiral micro-search. Validated on the physical robot; incremental success-rate impact is not yet quantified.
zh: 以 ROS 2 串接工業／協作型機械手臂平台、Isaac Sim／Isaac Lab、MoveIt 2 與 cuMotion，完成路徑規劃、碰撞處理、Pick-and-Place 與線材任務。
完成 Isaac GR00T N1.7 資料轉換、模型訓練與 Policy Inference，分別驗證虛擬資料訓練後的真實環境推論，以及真實資料訓練與推論流程。
建立透過 ROS 2／WebSocket 協作的兩部分訓練資料蒐集流程，自動控制機械手臂任務並記錄動作、影像、Robot State／Action 與 Timestamp，相同時間內資料量達人工操作的 3～4 倍，並節省兩名操作人力。
以 YOLO OBB／OpenCV 建置 HDMI 插線視覺伺服，以 AprilTag／OpenCV 完成線材拔線接頭定位；在最後插接階段整合腕部六軸力／扭矩感測與接觸搜尋，以受限範圍內的螺旋微動完成最後插接定位。已於真機驗證，額外成功率尚未量化。
